# Ilias Giannaros (GNRS)

> Ilias Giannaros — known online as GNRS — is a full-stack developer based in Kalamaria,
> Thessaloniki, Greece. He builds headless web architectures, custom WordPress and
> WooCommerce plugins, React/TypeScript frontends, and MCP servers with AI agent skills.
> Personal portfolio and services site: https://gnrs.gr
